title: Level-Change Nightly Charge Segment on an Assisted Living Respite Stay
content:
The re-leveled nights of a level change recorded on an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement are charged again as one level-change segment billing the stay type on record, starting on the first re-leveled night and ending on the last night of the segment that was credited.

## Rule

A level-change segment is fixed only after the stay's records carry a level-change adjustment credit for the nights being re-leveled.

The re-leveled nights of the segment are the nights of that level-change adjustment credit, and the segment that was credited is the stay's latest nightly charge segment.

Put the other way round: while the stay's records carry no level-change adjustment credit for the nights being re-leveled, no level-change segment is fixed for them.

## What the segment does

- It is one nightly charge entry on the stay account with the basis level change, naming the stay type billed — the stay type on record — and the first and last night of the segment and its nights.
- It raises the stay balance by the segment amount; the guest sees the segment on the stay statement and a higher balance owed.

## How it is invoked

The posting is made with the agent-side tool `charge_relevel_segment_3be81426`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call records one nightly charge entry, dated today.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `respite_stay_id` | Reference number of the respite or trial stay being charged, as returned by the stay lookup | Identifier |
| `tier_billed` | Stay type whose nights the segment bills | Exactly one of: Independent Living Trial Stay; Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care); Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care); Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care); Memory Care Respite Stay; Post-Hospital Recovery Stay |
| `segment_start_date` | First night of the segment | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD |
| `segment_end_date` | Last night of the segment | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD |
| `nights` | Number of nights in the segment | Whole number of nights |
| `segment_amount` | Amount charged for the segment in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new charge entry reference number, the stay reference number, the stay type billed, the first and last night (YYYY-MM-DD), the nights, the amount in USD with 2 decimal places and the resulting stay balance. A returned entry reference number means the segment was posted.
